Kartik Aaryan's New Film 'Kaaliya' Announced on His Birthday

Actor Kartik Aaryan's upcoming film, titled 'Kaaliya', was announced on his birthday. The film is a monster thriller collaboration with director Karan Johar. An announcement teaser was released, depicting a quiet scene in a small town where a child asks his mother for a bedtime story. The release date for 'Kaaliya' has also been unveiled.
